notes: 'I put words in their mouth to speak' is recast as 'I told them what they should say'. Corrected the verb: 'told' renders the idiom שׂים בְּפִי as a whole, so שׂים, בְּ and פֶּה fuse into one unit headed on the verb under rule 40 (as 'it displease'), rather than the verb alone taking 'told' with its partners unrepresented. Everything else stands as accepted.
